title: Sunset Canoe Tour of the Toronto Islands
blurb: Paddling at sunset, with an unmatched city skyline view, is a unique, romantic and relaxing experience that you can do right next to the Downtown Toronto. Getting to know the Toronto Islands with a guide and the island’s longtime resident, who would want to share his passion for nature and boats, might offer some new ideas about life approach and the way we appreciate the water and nature.
